introduction: Hawaiʻi H-HEAP has separate energy-credit and energy-crisis routes. Applications are processed by the Community Action Agency serving your island, not by the DHS office.
description: Hawaiʻi H-HEAP has separate energy-credit and energy-crisis routes. Applications are processed by the Community Action Agency serving your island, not by the DHS office.

sections.who: Eligible households must satisfy the local intake requirements. Crisis intervention concerns electricity or gas that has been disconnected or is scheduled for disconnection, supported by the utility’s notice.
sections.get: H-HEAP provides a one-time payment toward eligible electric or gas costs. The state says a household can receive only one type of H-HEAP payment per program year, October through September.
sections.docs:
• The current electric or gas bill.
  • A disconnection notice if requesting crisis help.
  • Household income and identity information required by the island agency.
sections.apply:
1. Contact your island agency

    Use DHS’s H-HEAP provider link. Do not send the application to a DHS office.

  2. Choose the appropriate route

    The published energy-credit window is June 1–30. Energy Crisis Intervention accepts requests year-round, with limited monthly approvals.

  3. Submit the local application

    Ask the provider for its current checklist and explain the service-disconnection date when relevant.
sections.after: Confirm whether a payment was approved and sent to the utility. An application does not itself guarantee funding or prevent disconnection; ask the utility about options while awaiting a decision.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Hawaiʻi H-HEAP routes and intake guidance. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Where do I submit the documents?
To the Community Action Agency serving your island. The state warns that sending them to DHS can delay processing.
Can I apply for crisis help outside June?
The state describes crisis intake as year-round, subject to limited monthly approvals.
Can I receive both assistance types in one year?
DHS says households can receive only one type of payment per October–September program year.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
